NATIVE SPEAKER ENGLISH
How come?
People often use How come? instead of Why?
A: I can't come to your wedding, I'm afraid.
B: Oh what a shame. How come?
A: I've got an exam that day.
PRONUNCIATION Responding
With positive responses our voice goes higher.
With negative responses our voice goes lower.
SPEAKING
A Work in pairs. Discuss these questions.
• Do you find it easy to talk about your feelings?
Who do you talk to if you have a problem?
• What would you do or say if a friend was upset?
Would it be different if it was a man or a woman?
• What kind of things do you do to cheer yourself up?
• Are you good at sorting out problems?
